name: ZIMMER BIOMET HOLDINGS, INC.
moat_justification: Leading share in knees/hips and durable ~70% gross margins, but roic_proxy in fundamentals.json ran 0.14%-4.5% FY2018-22 and only 6.88%/6.19%/4.75% FY2023-25 — below the cost of capital through the cycle on an acquisition-inflated capital base (~$10.6B goodwill + ~$8.8B intangibles from Biomet). Moderate/narrow moat.
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 9 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
WIDE_SCENARIO_SPREAD: super-bull IV is 4.5x super-bear IV — uncertainty is huge; confidence should not be high
HIGH_NET_DEBT: net debt is 4.8x normalized OE — levered OE can vanish fast; stress the bear cases
TIER_BAND: bear-case tier D (9.1%) vs bull-case tier C (14.9%) — the verdict spans tiers; size any position to the bear end
one_liner: Solid orthopedics franchise, moat 5/10 — at $94.98 it does not clear 15% (weighted IRR 12.4%, IV@15% $74.49); it clears the hurdle at ~$74.
moat_for: Surgeon training and hospital/GPO switching friction
ROSA robotics ecosystem ties procedures to the implant platform
Gross margin held ~69-73% for a decade — pricing power exists
moat_against: ROIC proxy below cost of capital through the whole measured cycle
Knees nearly flat (+0.4% Q2 2026) vs Stryker/DePuy robotics competition
Adjusted margins falling on acquisition mix (Paragon 28, Monogram); China volatility
